confirmed: Read the entire markdown conversion through the references and checked the relevant PDF pages. The local document is Kilian Wenker's revised manuscript dated 2023-02-17, explicitly not yet peer reviewed; it has 18 PDF pages, including the cover and 17 manuscript pages (PDF pp. 1-2 and 18). No appendix is included or supplement identified in this version.

online_rct is appropriate: employees of two companies in Germany completed an online survey on internal platforms and were randomly offered H-SRs, AI-SRs, or AI-SRs+TC (PDF p. 10, section 3.1). The paper explicitly describes artificial writing conditions (PDF pp. 15-16, section 4.2).

The task involved twelve emails; all three conditions allowed independently composed replies. AI-SRs+TC supplied the same AI suggestions with a few seconds per email, without an exact numerical time limit (PDF p. 10, section 3.1; PDF p. 12, section 4.1.1).

The sample statement is 346 participants, counting people rather than emails or ratings, and one participant was excluded for technical problems. The paper does not separately print totals labeled randomized or analyzed, or per-arm participant counts; the form appropriately retains null for those numbers (PDF p. 11, section 3.3).

The quantitative experiment is not a fewer-than-50-person study. The N=8 count concerns selected qualitative interviewees from the experiment, not a separate randomized experiment (PDF p. 11, section 3.3; PDF p. 14, section 4.1.3).

The provider and model that produced the AI smart replies are not identified. Google Cloud NLP API is explicitly the sentiment analysis tool, and whole responses were scored; the inferential aggregation unit is not explicitly specified (PDF pp. 10-11, sections 3.1-3.2 and 4.1.1).

The sole reported statistics string and one-line finding match the PDF: mean response sentiment is 0.58 for AI-SRs versus 0.47 for H-SRs, with Tukey q=13.05 for that pair. The text reports significance at the p=0.01 level and df=342, not an exact pairwise p-value (PDF p. 11, section 4.1.1; Figure 4 is on PDF p. 12).

Sentiment is an output-scored agency proxy, not creativity or diversity; suggestion acceptance and qualitative experiences supply the other reported results. No between-person similarity or diversity statistic is reported (PDF pp. 10-15, sections 3.2 and 4.1-4.2).

context_class=none is supported: this is an assisted-human randomized experiment with an ineligible outcome, not observational diversity evidence, an AI-versus-human creativity comparison, or a synthesis. There are no pooled estimates or study counts to extract (PDF pp. 10-16, sections 3-5).

No external funding and no conflict of interest are declared; these declarations coexist with the participating employers' recruitment and material contributions (PDF p. 16, declarations; PDF pp. 9-11, sections 2.4 and 3.1-3.3).
summary: The randomized smart-reply study has no creativity or diversity outcome, so core eligibility should be no. The numbers and source version match; exclusion, country, company-involvement, and routing fields need correction.
